name: Roofing
summary: Residential and commercial roofing services for inspections, leak repairs, storm damage, shingle replacement, flashing, ventilation, decking and coordinated insurance restoration work.
features: Flashing, vents, ridges and pipe boots

faqs.question: How do I know whether my roof needs repair or replacement?
faqs.answer: The decision depends on the roof age, extent of damage, active leaks, shingle condition, decking condition and whether a localized repair can provide a durable result.

faqs.question: Can hail damage be present without an active leak?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hail can damage shingles, flashing, vents and soft metals before water enters the building, so an inspection is important after a severe storm.

faqs.question: What is normally included in a full roof replacement?
faqs.answer: A typical replacement may include tear-off, underlayment, shingles, starter, ridge caps, flashing, pipe boots, ventilation, cleanup and replacement of damaged decking when approved or required.

faqs.question: Can you work from an insurance roofing estimate?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review the approved construction scope, compare it with visible site conditions and complete the covered roofing repairs or replacement. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier and policyholder.
